pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-02.png with Read. It loaded and I viewed it. Layout: a wide top panel, two middle panels (left wider), and a wide bottom panel.
pages.observation: How I read it: (1) Top: the caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' at top left, then the teal screen label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' at top right. Ananya is alone in the middle. (2) Middle left: Ananya says 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' (3) Middle right: Meera says 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.', then the teal label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' at the bottom. The 'And' continues Ananya's line naturally. (4) Bottom: 'One team. Better coordination.' with a very short tail to ananya at the left, and Meera at upper right. Issues: Page 1 ends with 'Let's make the rest simpler', and page 2 starts onboarding at once with no transition. It works only if the screens make clear that Welbuk is software; the caption alone does not say what Welbuk is. In the bottom panel the balloon's left edge runs into ananya's name label ('anany...' is cut off) and nearly touches the ananya face box. The balloon sits between the two characters and could crowd Ananya's face once drawn. Moving it above or right is suggested. The top-panel caption sits flush against the panel's top-left border. That is fine. The top-right teal label is far from Ananya, so it reads as a monitor, which is fine.
